statement: N-0075 invite password. Question: what password does the invite email carry? Options: (a) Warren's request: a fixed password the user cannot change for now; (b) a one-time password that must be changed at first sign-in; (c) no password in the mail, a single-use set-password link that expires in 72 hours. Evidence: auth.py stores PBKDF2 hashes and has set-password; the only mailer today is the shipping digest. Impact: (a) leaves a working credential in every mailbox for as long as it exists and cannot be rotated by the user; (b) limits that to first sign-in; (c) never puts a password in mail. Reversibility: high. Recommendation: (c), else (b). Roles stay the four existing roles.
